name: @chirag127/oz-tokens-base
description: The --oz-* CSS custom-property CONTRACT: color roles (bg/fg/accent/muted/border/surface), space scale, radii, font-family slots, motion durations. Ships sane defaults + a11y focus ring. Each site imports this then OVERRIDES the props with its own bespoke palette/type — shared contract, unique look. Pure CSS, no JS.
